setup.intro: Google Street View gives the best imagery and needs your own Google Maps key; Google's free monthly allowance covers normal play. The photo modes need no key.
setup.s1: In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable Maps JavaScript API.
setup.s2: Create an API key. Under Application restrictions, choose HTTP referrers and add this site's address only.
setup.s3: Set a budget alert and a daily quota so a leaked key can't run up charges.
setup.priv: Your key stays in this browser. It is sent only to Google.
menu.intro: Five rounds. The closer your pin, the higher the score, up to 5,000 per round.
room.ph: Room code (optional): everyone with the same code gets the same places
end.title: Game over
board.title: Leaderboard
set.title: Settings
set.relays.help: One relay address per line (wss://…). Used for scores and leaderboards.
set.data.help: Your account is a Nostr key stored in this browser. If you clear your browser data the account is lost, so use Back up key on the Play tab to save it, and Import key to use it on another device.
btn.wipe: Clear all data on this device
set.wipe.confirm: This removes your key, settings and streak from this device. Make sure you backed up your key. Continue?
set.badrelay: Enter at least one relay starting with wss://
streak.none: Finish today's daily challenge to start a streak.
acct.notice: Accounts here are Nostr keys saved in this browser. If you clear your browser data the account is lost, unless you back up your key (Back up key) and import it on any device later. Create an account now?
maps.title: Community maps
maps.help: Maps are lists of places made by players. Vote to lift the best to the top and sink the bad ones. Play uses the mode and imagery chosen on the Play tab.
maps.name: Map name
maps.how: Click the map to add a place, or paste one "latitude, longitude" per line. You need at least 5 places.
maps.signin: Sign in from the Play tab first (create an account or import a key).
maps.need: Add a name and at least 5 places.
maps.posted: Published. It can take a few seconds to show up. Press Back, then Refresh.
maps.empty: No maps yet. Create the first one.
duel.title: Duel
duel.help: Two players, same places, 6,000 health each. After every round the lower score loses health equal to the difference. Uses the mode and imagery chosen on the Play tab.
duel.idle: Create a duel and send the link to a friend, or enter a code to join.
duel.wait2: Waiting for your friend… Duel code: {c}
duel.cheat: Duel stopped: the opponent's guess could not be verified
set.rtc: Try a direct WebRTC connection for duels (faster; falls back to relays)
